# Pins pip itself for CI (REQ-SUP-001-AC13): every job that runs `pip install` first installs this one
# requirement, hash-checked, so the installer is as pinned as what it installs. Dependabot watches this
# directory under its 7-day cooldown, so a new pip release is only proposed once it has been public a week.
